ownership_map.resource: private local draft run directory and SQLite event store
ownership_map.retirement_mechanism: disarm and delete the private run directory after required evidence retention

ownership_map.provisioned_by: user-owned Yahoo account and browser-managed sign-in
allowed_runtime_operations: submit one exact pick after allow decision
ownership_map.retirement_mechanism: disarm the CLI and close the browser session normally

discovery.rationale: Objective, authority boundary, risk, and acceptance criteria are tracked.

architecture.rationale: Local runtime state and external Yahoo authority are separated with fail-closed handoff contracts.

development.rationale: The tool is typed, offline, dependency-light, explicit about bootstrap, and covered by deterministic tests.

data_ai.rationale: Only frozen public or manual inputs are accepted; provenance and freshness are visible; no model asset or online learning exists.

build_supply_chain.rationale: Runtime uses the Python standard library; pytest is the only development dependency.

verification.rationale: Offline tests cover deterministic behavior; witnessed browser rehearsal remains required before real automatic mode.

provisioning.rationale: Only the explicit init command can create the local SQLite schema; runtime commands validate and fail when it is absent.

release_deployment.rationale: This release is a local CLI with no deployed service or production environment.
release_deployment.applicability_rationale: There is no cloud artifact, deployment target, release identity, or production approval gate.

operations.rationale: Doctor, status, replay, disarm, and fail-closed intent decisions expose local operating state.

incident_recovery.rationale: Hash-chain replay, reconciliation, queue fallback, disarm, and takeover are tested offline; live browser recovery must be witnessed.

retirement.rationale: The run is retired by disarming, retaining only sanitized evidence, and deleting the private local directory.
